summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a CEO letter to shareholders dated August 13, 2026. The letter reviews first-half 2026 preliminary revenue of approximately $11 million (up ~120% year-over-year), cash of about $485 million, product certification progress, and reaffirmed full-year guidance. It also mentions the acquisition of IC ALPS in August 2025 and a $125 million registered direct offering in March 2026. This is routine shareholder communication, not a special-situation event. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or other special category applies; the filing is informational and forward-looking.
